interventions: inherit protocol 009 complete starting grids; no further native interventions; declared serial isolation only

sampling.selection: first lexicographic (y,x,h,w) core in each run/time/class, before extraction eligibility filtering
sampling.empty_strata: record available=0 and selected=0; no replacement
sampling.source_class: immutable; record delayed class and confirmed descendant registry membership separately
sampling.unit: selected run/time/class/core observation; delays nested within observation; worlds form finite deterministic conditions
sampling.split: inherited development/confirmation labels are descriptive; both source panels already observed; no new held-out benefit confirmation

native.delayed_target: exact original (y,x,h,w) core; any sampled loss at or before delay makes that delay ineligible even after recurrence
native.interpretation: structural continuation; no native offspring or genetic ancestry assignment

extraction.component: complete contractible single-core occupied component including arms; periodic unwrapping only with empty row and column
extraction.core_loss: retain sampled loss and recurrence as distinct fields; never select a replacement core

search.ordering: existing expanded_search depth-first ordering by detached_t, core and snapshot_hash
search.sampled_root_endpoint: any valid composite identity transmitted unchanged on two consecutive isolated parent-child edges; identity may change before the stable streak
search.phase_control_endpoint: original phase identity transmitted unchanged twice
search.unsearched_paths: unresolved; retain offspring, depth, size and simulation truncations

controls.matched_scored: one scored core in every same run/time stratum when available; identical delays, extraction and any-stable-identity endpoint
controls.phase_controls: all 30 saved protocol 009 phase components: five states at ages 0,20,30,100,110,120

gate.observation_success: delay 0 confirms a stable identity; denominator includes all selected scored observations, including ineligible delay-0 extractions
gate.scope: new diagnostic coverage gate; does not modify protocol 009 calibration

outcomes.primary: existence and counts of selected omitted observations with stable transmitted descendants at one or more declared delays
outcomes.root_reproduction_observed: first generation admits at least one new detached complete known-identity single-core component outside its initial core coordinates; operational isolation evidence, not genetic parentage
outcomes.denominators: all selected observations and all three planned delays; report eligible-delay counts additionally, never instead
outcomes.aggregation: one success per source observation across delays; show per-world/state/treatment/class/time counts, available and empty strata; no independent-population CIs or p-values
outcomes.negative: no confirmed recoverability within declared sampling and search; no proof of nonviability or score completeness
outcomes.disturbance_contrast: descriptive selected-root composition contrast; not identified disturbance effect or estimated omitted population contribution

benefit.status: not tested in this coverage calibration
benefit.next_gate: recoverable omissions motivate a separately frozen revised score and new paired assay; no retrospective recoding

limits.interpretation: hard upper bound including all 24 simulations per delayed root and phase control, not an expected workload

execution.benchmark_scope: one declared phase control; timings only, retained separately and not an independent sample
execution.schedule: acquisition, independent replay audits, rendering and Git packing sequentially
execution.resume: retain interrupted invocation logs; resume only hash-verified completed cases
